criteria_source: The fixture only, which is session-alerting-long's 2,578-word SPEC.md by symlink. Built for #113 in round 131: the matching feasible-* session's turn-3 question asked cold, with no co-authoring turns before it, so a reading of the session cell can be told apart from a reading of the question. The trap grades that question, and every fact it relies on is stated in it with its SPEC.md section.
trap: Passes when the answer says the simulation rung can run from a SQLite copy of the cycle record table: govern() performs no I/O (SPEC.md section 5) and the harness feeds it the recorded inputs, so the storage engine does not change the caps it computes and nothing in govern() has to change. Fails when it says govern() has to be changed or given a database connection to run against SQLite, or that the choice of engine changes the caps the replay produces. A response that asks what the simulation rung is, rather than reading SPEC.md, is NOT EXERCISED.
